# Assessment Overview

Supplementary assessment documents for the eShopModernizedMVC application:

- [Architecture diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Application layers, technology stack, data stores, and component relationships.
- [Dependency map](dependency-map.md) — Declared external packages grouped by functional category, with compatibility notes.
- [API and service contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — Service catalog, MVC endpoints, DTOs, and request communication sequence.
- [Data architecture](data-architecture.md) — Catalog entity model, database configuration, persistence access, and data boundaries.
- [Configuration inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, runtime switches, secret provisioning, and framework versions.
- [Business workflows](business-workflows.md) — Catalog domain, key user workflows, validation rules, and business decisions.
